title: Better options than fetching in Effects

slides.say: Fetching in an Effect works. But it is very manual, with real downsides.

slides.text: No server data (Effects don’t run on the server) • network waterfalls • no preload or cache • lots of boilerplate.
slides.say: Effects do not run on the server, so the first HTML has no data. Parents and children fetch one after another, a waterfall. Nothing is cached. And there is boilerplate to avoid race conditions.

slides.text: Using a framework? Use its built-in data fetching.
slides.say: If you use a framework, use its built in data fetching. It avoids these pitfalls.

slides.text: Otherwise: a client-side cache like TanStack Query, useSWR or React Router.
slides.say: Otherwise, use or build a client side cache, like TanStack Query, use SWR, or React Router. Fetching in Effects is still fine if neither fits.
